decision.reason: ETNews Oct 13 sector page reports Korean National Parks developing BandalLens AI 17-mammal camera trap labeling with claimed 99% review-time reduction. Separate user-supplied-label QA and human accepted species evidence register is an inference only, not an existing deployed commercial need.
decision.article_title: AI로 야생동물 자동 식별한다…영상 분석 시간 99% 단축 - 전자신문

opportunities.core_job: Track human validation and exception review of camera trap image AI labels against observation/site/date evidence
opportunities.target_customer: National parks biodiversity monitoring teams and ecological survey contractors
opportunities.product_mechanism: User CSV import of camera site, species prediction, manual accepted label and confidence → exception queue → ecological reviewer signoff → aggregated species counts/evidence export
opportunities.why_now: 2026-10-13 Korean National Parks Service reported BandalLens AI to classify 17 Korean mammal species from automated trap cameras with predicted 99% reduction in manual review time
opportunities.before_state: Camera trap species predictions require defensible human sampling, overrides and project reporting spread across export files
opportunities.after_state: Local deterministic rule/sample QC tracking, manual labels and human acceptance/export records; NO deployed ML model or camera API
